{{Quote|Where are you taking them?''"<br />"''To Coruscant.''"<br />"''Coruscant? Uh, that doesn't compute. Uh, wait, uh, you're under arrest!|The OOM command battle droid and Qui-Gon Jinn|<ref name="SWE1" />|audio=2163-Jinn-Arrest-TPM.flac}}
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], '''2163''' was a [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[OOM command battle droid/Legends|OOM command battle droid]] who [[Capture of Theed/Legends|guarded]] the [[Theed Hangar/Legends|Theed Hangar]] during the Trade Federation's [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|occupation]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. The [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] featured [[Color/Legends|tan]] plating with yellow markings, and had black eye [[Sensor/Legends|Sensors]]. Although command battle droids featured increased autonomy than regular [[Infantry/Legends|infantry]] units, it still struggled in complex situations. While guarding the hangar and a group of [[Prisoner/Legends|captured]] Naboo [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] shortly after the fall of the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] early in the invasion, 2163 tried to arrest [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] but was [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|destroyed]] by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] as the latter led an escape of the planet's [[Queen/Legends|Queen]], [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Halt!''"<br />"''I am ambassador to the Supreme Chancellor. I'm taking these people to Coruscant.|2163, to Jinn and his companions|audio=2163-Jinn-Halt-TPM.flac|<ref name="SWE1" />}}
A [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[OOM command battle droid/Legends|OOM command battle droid]] designated 2163 was present in the [[Theed Hangar/Legends|Theed Hangar]] in the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] while the Trade Federation [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|occupied]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]<ref name="SWE1" /> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]<ref name="NEC" /> to protest a [[Senate Resolution BR-0371|trade dispute]]. After the capital was [[Capture of Theed/Legends|secured]], the command [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] and subordinates such as units [[3B3-1204]] and [[1933/Legends|1933]] were guarding a group of [[Prisoner/Legends|captured]] [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Naboo Security Force]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] in the Theed [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] where the [[J-type 327 Nubian royal starship/Legends|royal]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] was also held.<ref name="SWE1" />

[[File:3B31204die.png|thumb|left|180px|Qui-Gon Jinn attacking 2163's group]]
With a group of four other battle droids, 2163 confronted [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] when Jinn tried to escape the planet with [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and her [[Naboo Royal Handmaidens/Legends|handmaidens]] and bodyguards inform the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] about the invasion. Halting in front of 2163, Jinn attempted to convince the command [[Droid/Legends|droid]] to let them pass and allow them to go to Coruscant as the [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]], which briefly confused the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]]. Jinn [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|destroyed]] 2163, after the latter ordered the Jedi's arrest, with a [[Sai tok/Legends|sweep]] of his [[Qui-Gon Jinn's lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] through the droid's torso, also beheading a nearby droid. Jinn and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], then proceeded to destroy the command droid's subordinates, to allow the Jedi and the entourage, including the exiled [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]], to escape on the Queen's starship.<ref name="SWE1" />

==Characteristics==
[[File:OOMCommander20questions.png|thumb|right|200px|The OOM droid orders Qui-Gon Jinn's arrest.]]
The [[OOM-series battle droid/Legends|OOM]] command battle droid 2163 had a set of [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] along with tan plating.<ref name="SWE1" /> He<ref name="SWE1 novel" /> was 1.91 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in height.<ref name="Databank" /> Yellow markings on its torso and head<ref name="SWE1" /> marked 2163's status as a command battle droid with increased autonomy compared to the regular units.<ref name="Databank" /> Additionally, the droid's designation was imprinted on the back.<ref name="SWE1" /> 2163 contained programming which allowed it to adapt to circumstances, which sometimes malfunctioned,<ref name="CCGTPL">{{CCG|set=Theed Palace Limited|cardname=Battle Droid Officer}}</ref> causing the droid to stutter or declare that a statement did not compute.<ref name="SWE1" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Where are ''you'' going?|2163, to Jinn, in an altered scene in ''The Phantom Menace''{{'s}} junior novelization|<ref name="SWE1 junior novel">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (junior novelization)|''Star Wars Episode I: The Phantom Menace'' junior novelization]]</ref>}}
2163 was created for the [[1999]] [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']] film.<ref name="SWE1" /> Prior to the film's [[May 19]] release,<ref name="Year by Year">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''</ref> the droid appeared in the [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization]],<ref name="SWE1 novel" /> released on [[April 21]], 1999,<ref name="Noveldate">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref> the [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (junior novelization)|junior adaptation]],<ref name="SWE1 junior novel" /> and the [[Mighty Chronicles]] [[The Phantom Menace (Mighty Chronicles)|adaptation]]<ref name="Mighty">[[The Phantom Menace (Mighty Chronicles)|''The Phantom Menace'' Mighty Chronicles adaptation]]</ref> both of which were released in [[May]] 1999.<ref name="Juniordate">{{CollectorCite|6|The Padawan Reading List}}</ref><ref name="MightyChronicles date">{{Chronicle|old=1|url=cgi-bin/Adult/view.cgi?isbn=0811823156|text=Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace}}</ref> The designation was printed on its back in the film, such as other droids like [[1138 (Trade Federation)/Legends|1138]].<ref name="SWE1" /> In the novel,<ref name="SWE1 novel" /> the Mighty Chronicles<ref name="Mighty" /> and the junior adaptation, the battle droid has a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], which it does not have in the film, as well as altered dialogue.<ref name="SWE1 junior novel" /> The droid is also described as being split into two in the Mighty Chronicles adaptation.<ref name="Mighty" /> 2163 was voiced by [[Peter Serafinowicz]], the actor who also dubbed the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul's]] voice in the film.<ref name="My Star Wars">{{InsiderCite|117|My Star Wars|My ''Star Wars'': Peter Serafinowicz}}</ref>
